title: Store bidirectional relationships in issue model
description:
Implement bidirectional relationship storage with format versioning.

Versioning strategy:
- v1 (implicit): Current format, relations on one side only. No .format file needed.
- v2+: Marked by .format file in .pebbles/ directory containing version string (e.g., 'v2')

New RelationType variants (inverses):
- part_of ↔ has_part
- required_for ↔ requires
- scheduled_before ↔ scheduled_after

Changes needed:
1. Introduce .format file concept in .pebbles/ directory
2. Add HasPart, Requires, ScheduledAfter to RelationType enum
3. Implement bidirectional relationship storage as v2 format
4. Update relationship logic to maintain both directions automatically
5. Plan (document only) migration path for v1→v2
6. Update SPEC.md to document versioning and bidirectional storage
7. Update display logic from relationship UX pebble to use direct references instead of searching

Referenced by:
  scheduled after 48e1d52e (Display all relationships when showing an issue)

NOTE 2026-09-22 (manager): incoming relationships are COMPUTED at read time (models.rs incoming helper + display shows them), not stored; whether to store both directions or keep computing is an open design question. Reverted to proposed for owner review.

NOTE 2026-09-23 (manager): closed per owner. Incoming relationships are computed at read time (models.rs incoming helper + display), so bidirectional storage is not needed.
